units: <cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 1:3">Ab. Zar. I, 3</cite> <he>יום הל׳</he> birthday.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:3:19">Y. Ber. II, 4ᵈ</cite> top <he>אשרי … כשעת לֵידָתוֹ וכ׳</he> happy he whose time of death is like his time of birth, as when he was born he was innocent &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 2:6">Sabb. II, 6</cite> <he>בשעת לֵידָתָן</he> (or <cite ref="L00512"><he>לִידְתָּן</he></cite>) in their hour of confinement.

<cite ref="Niddah 29b:14">Nidd. 29ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.—<he>טמאה ל׳</he> (sub. <he>טומאת</he>) subject to the laws of cleanness for a woman in confinement (<cite ref="Leviticus 12:2-8">Lev. XII, 2—8</cite>). Ib. 23ᵇ; a. fr.—Pl. <he>לֵידוֹת</he>. Y. ib. III, 50ᶜ; a. fr.
